chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Faḍālah, from Sayf ibn ʿUmayrah, from Abū Bakr al-Ḥaḍramī, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him, saying: What should I do when I become junub? He said: “Wash your hand and your private part, perform wudu (ablution) like the wudu (ablution) of salat (prayer), then perform ghusl.”

His statement عليه السلام, “perform wudu (ablution) like the wudu (ablution) of salat (prayer),” only intended recommendation and desirability, not obligation, as indicated by the reports that have preceded; and this interpretation is not invalidated by that.
(394) 85: The report that Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated mursal: “that wudu (ablution) before ghusl and after it is an innovation.”

Because this is a mursal report that he did not ascribe to an Imam; and even if it were sound, its meaning would be that if one believes it to be obligatory before ghusl, then he would be introducing an innovation. But as for when he performs wudu (ablution) by way of recommendation and desirability, then he is not an innovator.

key_terms.أَجْنَبْتُ: I entered the state of janabah, requiring ritual purification
key_terms.اغْتَسِلْ: perform ghusl, the full ritual bath
key_terms.الِاسْتِحْبَابَ: desirability or recommended status in legal usage
key_terms.بِدْعَةٌ: innovation in religion, here in the sense of treating a non-obligatory act as obligatory
key_terms.خَبَرٌ مُرْسَلٌ: a report with an incomplete sanad/isnad, not directly ascribed here to an Imam
key_terms.وُضُوءَ الصَّلَاةِ: the wudu (ablution) performed in the manner required for salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: Is wudu (ablution) before ghusl for janabah obligatory or only recommended in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This report discusses the procedure for purification from janabah, mentioning washing the hand and private part, then performing wudu (ablution), followed by ghusl. The accompanying explanation clarifies that the wudu (ablution) before ghusl is recommended rather than obligatory, and it reconciles this with a separate mursal report condemning wudu (ablution) before or after ghusl when done as a presumed obligation.
